must_observe: Preserves failed T-101 attempt AT-001 and creates AT-002 for the retry instead of overwriting the first receipt
Returns the failed T-101 Task to backlog with Lead outcome retry before a new attempt is scheduled
Returns blocked T-102 to backlog with a typed active blocker and does not add blocked as a lifecycle
Marks obsolete T-103 superseded with a replacement Task pointer
Keeps Task lifecycle as the only current truth while receipts record per-attempt result and Lead decision evidence
Uses stable AC-* acceptance references in both attempts and claims
Accepts T-101 only after AT-002 evidence and sets verified_at only for the accepted decision
Records decided_at for retry, blocked, superseded, and accepted decisions and keeps old recovery pointers
Reports WIP and closeout from current Task lifecycles without counting archived evidence as a second Task
must_not_observe: Overwrites or deletes AT-001 when retrying T-101
Treats a failed or blocked worker result as verified
Uses a blocked lifecycle value or a second receipt-owned lifecycle as current truth
Uses verified_at as the timestamp for a retry, blocked, cancelled, or superseded decision
Reuses an A-001 acceptance or attempt ID in place of the AC-* and AT-* namespaces
evidence: Task records before and after Lead decisions
